name: Seller Book
office_task: Each morning, show me which past sellers and appraisals in my own database to text today and why, drafted for my OK, and keep every outcome and follow-up on the contact.
systems_of_record: the agency CRM (Agentbox, VaultRE, Rex or similar), or the copied Contacts sheet, that holds each contact row, its last outcome and date, its texts and the do-not-contact register
the place the agent opens each morning (CRM tasks or the Today tab), which issues the report_id for each day's list of drafted texts

emits.write: the day's list of drafted seller texts for the agent's OK: at most the cap they set, in rank order, each row with its play, the trigger that qualified it, the drafted text naming that trigger, the sender and a STOP opt-out, and the last outcome. Nothing is sent until the agent OKs it
emits.readback: the list store returns a report_id for the day's list, and reading that id back returns the same rows in the same order; no id back means no list was published and the run raises an exception

emits.write: a thing to sort out, naming the agent who owns it: a seller reply that asks for a price or an offer, a complaint, a reply the play was not built for, or a contact missing name, mobile or address
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading that id back returns the contact, the typed reason and the exception_owner; no id back means nothing was raised and the run stops
